info.description: Path-style SigV4 header and presigned authentication; no virtual-host addressing. Fixed SHA256 payloads and STREAMING-AWS4-HMAC-SHA256-PAYLOAD with chained chunk signatures are supported. SigV4a, checksum trailers, server-side encryption, object lock and SDK checksum-algorithm headers return 501. Region discovery returns us-east-1. Root and /s3 aliases are signed using their actual paths; never rewrite a signed request.
